item.description: S. Joann Hammonds, 88, of Harrisonville, Missouri, passed away on Monday, January 5, 2026, at her home. Funeral services will be held on Friday, January 9, 2026 at 11:00 AM at Harrisonville United Methodist Church in Harrisonville, MO, with a visitation beginning at 10:00 AM. Interment will follow in Freeman Cemetery in Freeman, MO.A complete obituary will be posted when it is available. Courtesy Atkinson Funeral Home

item.title: Bates County Memorial Hospital Introduces Platelet-Rich Plasma Therapy for Orthopedic Conditions
item.description: Bates County Memorial Hospital (BCMH) is expanding access to orthopedic care by offering Platelet-Rich Plasma (PRP) injections, a minimally invasive treatment option for select orthopedic conditions. PRP therapy will be available through BCMH Orthopedic Clinics beginning January 2026.PRP therapy uses a concentrated portion of a patient’s own blood to support the body’s natural healing response. item.title: Obituary - Sharon Berry
item.description: Sharon Kathleen (Burnett) Berry, 75, Nevada, MO passed away on Friday, January 2, 2026 at Moore-Few Care Center in Nevada. She was born August 19, 1950 in Nevada to Clyde and Rose (Beaver) Burnett. Sharon is survived by her longtime companion, Charlie Schulze of the home. She was preceded in death by her parents, and a brother, Ron Burnett.No services are planned. Courtesy Ferry Funeral Home

item.title: Lowry City set for April 7 Election
item.description: Seven local residents signed up for three seats opening on the Lowry City Board of Aldermen in April 2026Kevin Snyder Jr., Cecil Shehorn and Incumbent Jackie Cutler have signed up to run for east ward alderman.Clark Patterson and Incumbent Shirley Edmunds have signed up to run for west ward alderman.Incumbent Patricia Landes and Greg BeVelle have signed up to run for the mayor’s seat.The election is slated for April 7, 2026Make plans to vote!!!https://lowrycitymo.gov/news-detail?item_id=30873

item.title: Bench Trial set for Michael Kocurek tomorrow
item.description: The bench trial for Michael A. Kocurek of Butler is scheduled to begin Tuesday January 6, at the Bates County Courthouse. Kocurek, 50 was charged with in 2017 with 1st Degree Sodomy, 1 Count of 1st degree statutory rape, and 2 counts of 1st degree child endangerment. District Defender Jeff Martin will present the defense on behalf of Kocurek.Kocurek waived his right to a jury trial and his fate will be decided by Senior Judge James Journey of the 27th Circuit.
